👕 Outfit: Hero Costume: Armored
A hero costume of segmented armor plates over a padded undersuit.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Outfit - Hero Costume: Armored.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Segmented armor plates over a padded black undersuit: a chest plate, layered shoulder guards, forearm bracers, thigh plates and shin guards over reinforced boots. The plates are matte with beveled edges and visible fastening straps. The head stays bare so the face is visible; a matching helmet appears only when the selected pose carries one. Default colors: steel-gray plates with dark red edge trim, replaced by the character's established costume colors when stated. No lettering. Cut openings for any established wings, tail or extra arms.

Portrait only: inventory and equipped items stay as they are. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; the garment adds no Quirk effect, gear function, rank, license or affiliation. Respect the selected crop.
